tool_signatures.name: update_auth_oauth_server
tool_signatures.description: Configures Neon Auth as an OAuth 2.1 authorization server for the branch, including for MCP servers. This is Better Auth's OAuth Provider plugin (API plugin oauth_provider), not social login; for providers such as GitHub or Google see list_auth_oauth_providers. Enabling requires login_page, consent_page and at least one resource (or an MCP resource). resources replaces the stored list: call get_auth_oauth_server first and send the full list to add or remove one. mcp.resource is required whenever mcp is sent; omitted mcp booleans keep their stored value, and mcp.resource: "" removes the MCP configuration. Prefer client_id_metadata_documents over the deprecated dynamic_registration. branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.
